PHOTOREALISTIC live-action feature-film environment with credible engineering, photographic optics and physically based VFX. Event Unstable Lift from Mindrealm Bastion. Environment dominates, tiny human scale reference, no hero portrait.
Story: a heavy industrial elevator has stalled between two memory-factory levels. An unregistered mechanical relic is caught just above its roof, intermittently hidden by unstable electrical illumination. The drive still holds usable energy. A resistance technician may risk reaching the relic or safely dismantle the drive coil from a maintenance landing. Present both routes in a single believable physical space, before a choice.
Shot: dramatic steep oblique bird's-eye 20mm view from a high service landing down a city-scale elevator shaft. A tilted yellow-gray freight cage hangs on multiple taut cables in the left-center, between concrete floor decks that continue far below. Directly above the cage roof a small intricate silver relic canister is snagged on a cable bracket, catching a narrow white work light. A large open motor housing with exposed copper drive coil sits on a safe left maintenance landing, connected to a metal ladder. A tiny technician in navy coveralls, lime safety vest, climbing helmet and tether harness stands on the landing, only 7 percent of frame height, looking toward the trapped cage.
Physical world: immense poured-concrete shaft, steel guide rails, cable drums, bolted counterweight tracks, honest welds, rust stains, oil-wet metal, thick black rubber power cables, dust and condensation. Functional post-collapse cyberpunk infrastructure, not fantasy architecture. All cages, controls, floor plates and tools are entirely unmarked.
Lighting and palette: nighttime industrial darkness; harsh neutral-white inspection lamps and sparse deep cobalt electrical spill illuminate weathered yellow paint, red-brown rust and raw concrete. A single brief small arc at a damaged contact suggests instability, not a magical storm. Strong realistic depth and layered shaft haze, no generic teal-orange grade.
Layout: the cage, snagged relic, drive coil, ladder and tiny technician occupy the left and center 60 percent. The rightmost 32 percent fades into low-contrast shadowed shaft wall and deep haze with no bright strips or focal objects, usable for later choices. The bottom-left 25 percent is a dark soft foreground lip of the maintenance platform, low-detail for prose. The composition is continuous, with no panels.
Strictly no text, letters, numerals, floor numbers, labels, signs, warning plaques, logos, pictograms, visible interfaces, watermark, black bars, borders or collage. No illustration brushwork, painterly look, low-poly, toys, magic, medieval robes, hoods or capes. Physically supported objects, believable danger and immense industrial scale.

previousRevision.finalPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original narrative event CG for the science-fiction roguelike tower-defense game Mindrealm Bastion.
Primary request: Create a premium semi-realistic painterly science-fiction scene for the event Unstable Lift. The lift car is stranded between two mental levels. An unregistered relic hangs above its roof and flickering currents push it deeper into shadow. Crossing the unstable levels to recover it threatens the waking ember; dismantling the still-charged drive coil from the safe maintenance route can salvage focus. Show the moment before this choice.
Scene/backdrop: an immense industrial lift shaft with the damaged lift hanging between displaced levels, fractured shaft rings, heavy suspension cables, brushed-silver power coils and worn concrete maintenance structures. Restrained cyan spatial and temporal distortions make several shaft rings appear slightly misaligned. A secure maintenance ladder and accessible drive assembly communicate the alternative repair and salvage route.
Subject: one masked frequency dissident stands on a safe maintenance platform at the left, holding the rail with one hand and cautiously reaching toward a small suspended relic glowing amber above the stranded lift roof near the left-center. Keep the relic visibly just beyond easy reach, separated by the distorted shaft.
Style/medium: premium semi-realistic painterly science-fiction narrative CG, cinematic environmental concept painting, tactile brushed metal and weathered concrete, soft painterly edges, subtle analog film grain.
Composition/framing: request 2048x1152 landscape, full illustrated composition. Keep the dissident, suspended relic, lift and power coils in the left and center 60 percent. Keep the rightmost 32 percent calm, darker, lower contrast and visually sparse for a future choice interface, with distant shaft walls fading into atmospheric depth. Keep the bottom-left 25 percent dark and low-detail for future story copy. Maintain a coherent vast industrial shaft across the whole frame.
Lighting/mood: cinematic soft key lighting, muted cyan electrical shimmer, a restrained warm amber relic as the focal highlight, suspended motion, vertigo and careful resolve.
Color palette: muted silver, graphite and teal with restrained warm amber.
Constraints: one original scene, no frames, no cards, no buttons, no interface elements, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. No pixel art, no toy-like low-poly look. Opaque background.
